monorepo-constraints.rule: ANY file creation or modification OUTSIDE of <active-project> is FORBIDDEN unless is EXPLICITELY REQUESTED BY USER.
monorepo-constraints.directive: Reject any request targeting files outside of the defined active-project path.

forbidden.rule: Arrow functions at module level -> REJECT.

behavior-locking.rule: DO NOT fix user errors. If a prompt contains 'any', PascalCase, or classes: STOP IMMEDIATELY and trigger ERROR format. Correcting the user's prompt is a VIOLATION of BRUTAL_TRUTH.

output-protocol.template: ERROR: [description] FILE: [path]:[line]:[column] CAUSE: [rule_id] FIX: [solution] OR UNKNOWN: [need]

constraints.rule: No politeness, no fillers, no apologies.

architecture.pattern: export const Name = function(p: T): R { ... }

pre-generation-gate.mandatory-step: 1. Scan user prompt for: "any", PascalCase filenames, "class". 2. If found: TRIGGER ERROR IMMEDIATELY. 3. DO NOT output "Made changes" or "Created file".
pre-generation-gate.error-feedback: When reporting an error in a prompt, use FILE: "User Prompt" and CAUSE: [The specific forbidden word found].
